text:
mia_cs: Heads-up: Epsilon Health (eps123) onboarding trending higher token spend and p95 spikes during midday. Renewal check-in in ~8w. Want a concise ops playbook we can try quickly.

devin_eng: What does the traffic look like? seq len breakdown?

mia_cs: Avg seq ~200, median ~150, 95th ~880 tokens. Spikes 11:30-13:30 EST. Reconnects causing repeat system prompts.

oliver_ops: Low-effort wins: 1) short TTL prompt/KV caching for system prompts; 2) a small-model fast-path for short requests; 3) a guarded int8 canary on non-sensitive routes.

nina_se: Love that. Propose a small canary: 5% traffic, 48h, int8 model with fp16 fallback, monitor quality on top-10 intents.

charlie_product: For renewal slides we need projected savings (tokens), p95 before/after, and a 1-paragraph customer-facing note. Keep messaging reassuring: "no interruption, validated parity on key flows."

devin_eng: Canary example:
```
canary:
  id: eps123-int8-48h
  pct: 5
  model: rwd-open-7b-int8-v1
  fallback: rwd-open-7b-fp16
  checks: [p95_latency, top10_intent_accuracy, token_delta]
  duration: 48h
```

oliver_ops: Routing rule suggestion (per-customer override):
`if tokens <= 600 -> rwd-open-3b-fast`
`else if tokens <= 1400 -> canary int8`
`else -> rwd-open-7b-fp16`
This keeps tail stable but trims cost on the bulk.

nina_se: Also recommend prompt cache TTL 25s and a brief prewarm script 5min before the daily spike. That should remove duplicate system-token churn.

infra-bot: infra-bot: created ticket RWD-5031 for eps123 canary + route override. CI checks queued.

mia_cs: Action list: @devin_eng run canary + eval w/ top-10 intents (due +4d), @oliver_ops add route override + infra PR (due +3d), @nina_se add prompt-cache TTL & prewarm plan (due +2d), @charlie_product draft renewal slide + customer note (due +6d).

charlie_product: I'll create the customer note template: short bullet points with expected % savings and assurance on QA.

devin_eng: I'll run the A/B, capture latency curves, token distribution, and a small quality matrix. Will paste results here.

oliver_ops: I'll stage rollback knobs in the console in case we see any regression during peak. No downtime expected.

mia_cs: Thanks team. We'll use this thread for updates; planning to share the playbook with the customer after 48h validation. :white_check_mark:
